# Repeatable (10-year cooldown): Grand Overland Caravan between Constantinople and Dadu.
oe_srk_dec_overland_caravan = {
    decision_category = economy_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        oe_srk_rule_enabled = yes
        oe_srk_is_protagonist = yes
        OR = {
            global_var:oe_srk_land_charter ?= 1
            oe_srk_concordat_signed = yes
        }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 100
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_srk_land_cd }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:nobles } }
    option = {
        name = oe_srk_dec_overland_caravan.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -100
            set_variable = { name = oe_srk_land_cd months = 120 }
            oe_srk_apply_bilateral_mod = { mod = oe_srk_overland_charter months = 120 }
            oe_srk_apply_bilateral_bias = { bias = oe_srk_b_trade_envoys }
        }
    }
}

            oe_srk_concordat_signed = yes
        }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 100
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_srk_sea_cd }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:soldiers } }
    option = {
        name = oe_srk_dec_maritime_voyage.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -100
            set_variable = { name = oe_srk_sea_cd months = 120 }
            oe_srk_apply_bilateral_mod = { mod = oe_srk_maritime_link months = 120 }
            if = {
                limit = { oe_srk_is_west_host = yes }
                location:constantinople = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_srk_porcelain_port months = 120 mode = replace } }
            }
            else = {
                location:jinjiang = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_srk_porcelain_port months = 120 mode = replace } }
            }
        }
    }
}

        NOT = { var:oe_srk_symp_done ?= 1 }

    allow = {

    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:clergy background = pop_type:burghers } }
    option = {
        name = oe_srk_dec_scholar_mission.a
        effect = {

            add_gold = -120
            add_stability = -5
